name: Keith A. Clouse
tagline: Top rated Employment & Labor attorney in Dallas, Texas
about: Keith A. Clouse is an attorney providing legal services covering Employment & Labor: Employee and Employment & Labor: Employer.

Keith Clouse, who practices law in Dallas, Texas, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2003 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at Tulane University Law School. He graduated in 1989. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1989.
